response.sql: WITH per_order AS (SELECT orderslink, AVG(rebtotal) AS avg_total_rebate, AVG(rebrate / NULLIF(feerate, 0)) AS avg_ratio FROM fees WHERE rebrate > 0.0005 AND orderslink IS NOT NULL GROUP BY orderslink), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS mean_ratio FROM per_order) SELECT p.orderslink, p.avg_total_rebate, p.avg_ratio, p.avg_ratio / NULLIF(o.mean_ratio, 0) AS relative_ratio FROM per_order AS p CROSS JOIN overall AS o ORDER BY relative_ratio DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Rows without an order link are excluded because they do not identify an order. Zero fee rates produce missing ratios; a zero overall mean produces missing relative ratios.
